Select approved drugs with max_phase_for_ind = 4 and mesh_heading 'type 2 diabetes mellitus'. Join molecule_dictionary to drug_indication on molregno. Join compound_structures as an INNER JOIN on molregno to require structures. Return chembl_id, pref_name, canonical_smiles, efo_id as indication_curie, efo_term as indication_label, and max_phase_for_ind. Sort by chembl_id, pref_name, canonical_smiles, indication_curie, indication_label, max_phase_for_ind.
